posts.content_md: After it set for a while, I would say and hour or two, then you recoat. If there is a little melding of the two that would be ok but you would still have two layers with different concentration of AmDi. As concentration effects replay wavelength, I believe you would get more of a broadband replay. The question is, would the two replay colors be registered?
